title: G18 before/after: octopus-pincer: before the fix
prompt: retrieve the cube from the station and deliver it to the tray, then return (no language planner)

outcome.text: FAILED: before the fix (pincer hinges that open to -0.9 rad and finger pads with torsional friction (second-version body)), mobile_octopus, seed 1. Reason: acquire: grasp miss 8.5 cm across, -0.6 cm up; the object moved 0.0 cm. Symptom: the first version's open fingers parted less than the cube, so the pincer could not close on it. One of a before/after pair on identical physics.

notes: See docs/results/g18-report.md.
